turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Taylor calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Ting Guo?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $1,611.57.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. My hours at work were reduced in Feb.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm originally from overseas.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $615 the 26th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
